name: donut-shop
title: Donut Shop
description: A dessert shop screen where the products roll. Swipe and the donuts roll across the carousel like wheels; "+" grows into a stepper and an add-to-cart bar rises; tap the donut and it zooms out to the edge of the screen, still turning, beside its nutrition. The donuts are drawn — icing, sprinkles, drizzle — with light that stays put while they spin, or pass your own round product art.
